func run(items: [Int], width: Int) async throws {
 for start in stride(from: 0, to: items.count, by: width) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
  try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
   for item in items[start..<min(start+width, items.count)] {
    group.addTask { try await read(item) }
   }
   // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
   try await group.waitForAll()
  }
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
  try await other(start)
 }
 for start in stride(from: 0, to: items.count, by: 1) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
  try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
   group.addTask { try await read(items[start]) }
   // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
   try await group.waitForAll()
  }
 }
}
